name: tournewzealand-com
description: www.tournewzealand.com — repo root. The site is web/, the Studio is studio/; schema/, config/, project.jsonc and migration-scripts/ are shared by both.

scripts.//: The trailing `--` on every delegating script is load-bearing. Without it, `npm run localise:assets -- --dry-run` appends the flag to THIS command, where npm reads it as its own flag and never forwards it — and localise:assets then writes instead of reporting.
scripts.deploy: npm run guard:deploy && npm run build && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.prod.jsonc
scripts.//preflight: Needs a RUNNING SERVER, because every page renders on demand: VERIFY_BASE=http://localhost:4322 npm run preflight
scripts.preflight: npm run build && npm test && npm run test:templates && npm run check && npm run verify -- --cms --routes && npm run verify:assets && npm run sitemap && npm run assets:check && npm run sanity:verify
